description: This file is a shell script that defines functions for extracting embedded trash directories from logs. It reads input, detects specific start and end markers for trash directories, and extracts and decompresses embedded data. It also removes CR line endings for compatibility across systems.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Outputs an error message to stderr and exits with status 1.

methods.name: find_embedded_trash
methods.description: Reads lines to identify the start marker of a trash directory and sets 'test_name'.

methods.name: extract_embedded_trash
methods.description: Processes input lines to extract embedded trash data until the end marker is found.
